samira: Quick round  we need a compact benchmark play for the launch: one clear hero visual for the blog (non-technical), plus a heatmap and ops flow for the webinar appendix. Core message: predictable latency and clear unit economics across hosted/dedicated/private.
aj: For the hero, one scatter: x = $/1k tokens, y = p95 latency (ms). Annotate three anchors: interactive chat, batched summarization, bulk embeddings. Keep copy punchy. :zap:
matt: Webinar appendix = heatmap (batch size x seq len -> $/token). Overlay two dashed bands to show typical hosted vs dedicated price points. Add a tiny code snippet to reproduce:```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('bench_snapshot.csv')
heat = df.pivot_table(index='seq_len', columns='batch', values='cost_per_token')
sns.heatmap(heat, cmap='magma')
```
elena: Data/provenance notes: include region (us-west-2), model names + exact revisions, quantization assumptions, and sample sizes per cell. Flag synthetic workloads and scrub any customer traces. Add a footnote about amortized infra costs.
samira: Landing flow: two radios  "Self-serve (PLG)" and "Enterprise (SLA & compliance)". If Enterprise, route to AE with fields: region, expected QPS, security needs. Add utm=bench_launch.
aj: Copy options for hero headline: 1) "Predictable serving. Predictable spend." 2) "Serving economics you can act on." Lean 1. Social shortline: "Predictable serving, smarter spend."
matt: I uploaded the CSV + raw slices: https://docs.internal/redwood/benchmarks/snapshots/5101234567 (sheet = single source). I will add heatmap CSV by EOD.
